errors.text_span: beginning at a loss of about 2.70
errors.evidence: The red line for SepLLM starts with its first data point at a loss of approximately 2.71. Stating it begins at 'about 2.70' is an inaccurate approximation that also exaggerates the initial difference from the Vanilla model.
The visual element is not a 'vertical bracket' but a set of two vertical dashed lines and a horizontal double-arrow, used to highlight the time interval on the x-axis.
The description omits the green star marker at the end of the annotation for the 'Vanilla' model, which indicates the point where the loss reaches 2.50 at approximately 250,000 seconds.
